findings.description: Enrollment stated as '211 enrolled across all arms' (sec 3 intro and 3.7), but summing enrolled/randomized per-trial gives 212 (34+149+25+4); 211 equals the TREATED sum (34+148+25+4) since Mahlapuu reports 149 randomized/148 treated. The '211 enrolled' label conflates randomized vs treated by one subject. Immaterial to conclusions but internally inconsistent with the report's own tables.

Three unified bibliography entries are non-resolvable placeholders/aggregates rather than specific citations: [3] is an explicit retained-slot pointer to [1]/[4]; [35] is a generic ClinicalTrials.gov/FDA not-approved pointer; [42] is the UCLA Koon/Cheng/Pothoulakis colitis cluster with PMIDs 'not individually re-verified.' Each is transparently disclosed and [35]/[42] are not used to ground efficacy, so honesty is preserved, but none yields an independently resolvable primary identifier.

Paywall-gated Barlow 2011 magnitudes (sec 7.2: '~70-80% titer reduction day 3', '~60% vs 0% survival') are presented inline with apparent precision; the abstract-verified/not-independently-re-derived caveat follows only in a trailing parenthetical, so the numbers read as established before the hedge. Hedge is present and correct but sequencing makes the figures look firmer than the evidence supports.

EU/EMA and non-US regulatory status is recorded as 'no approval found' and flagged as a coverage gap (sec 4.2/4.4) rather than affirmatively searched, despite the pivotal Phase IIb being EU-conducted (EudraCT 2018-000536-10). An affirmative EMA/EU-investigational-status check would close a small gap. Honestly disclosed, hence minor.
